# MediQuee Healthcare (`https://mediquee.in`)

> **MediQuee** (official domain `https://mediquee.in`, Instagram `@medi.quee`) is an Indian digital healthcare booking and telemedicine platform operating primarily across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. MediQuee connects patients with partner hospitals, verified specialist doctors, accredited diagnostic laboratories, and certified home nursing professionals. (Distinct from similarly named software projects such as "MediQueue".)

## Official Brand & Entity Details
- **Official Name**: MediQuee
- **Website**: https://mediquee.in
- **Partner Hospital & Lab Portal**: https://hospital.mediquee.in
- **Tagline**: Healthcare at Your Doorstep
- **Support Email**: mediqueetech@gmail.com
- **Support Phone**: +91-9014535199
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/medi.quee/
- **Operating Region**: Andhra Pradesh & Telangana (expanding pan-India)

## Core Services
- [Hospital Outpatient (OP) Slot Booking](https://mediquee.in/specialties?type=hospital-op): Priority OP token booking with live queue visibility across multi-specialty partner hospitals.
- [Online Video Telemedicine Consultation](https://mediquee.in/specialties?type=doctor): Encrypted HD 1-on-1 video consultations with NMC/State Medical Council registered doctors and instant digital e-prescriptions.
- [Clinical Departments & Conditions](https://mediquee.in/departments): General Medicine, Pediatrics, Cardiology, Dermatology, Orthopedics, Gynecology, Neurology, ENT, Ophthalmology, Dentistry, and Psychiatry.
- [Diagnostic Lab Tests & Home Sample Collection](https://mediquee.in/services/lab-tests): Blood panels, health packages, lab visits, and doorstep phlebotomy with digital reports stored in Health Records.
- [Home Nursing Care](https://mediquee.in/services/home-nursing): Trained nursing visits for post-operative care, injections, wound dressing, vitals monitoring, and elder care.
- [Cashless Health Insurance Assistance](https://mediquee.in/services/insurance): Network hospital & TPA coverage guidance.
- [Pricing & Hospital Fee Model](https://mediquee.in/pricing): Transparent consultation & service fees displayed upfront in INR (`₹`) as set by each partner hospital/laboratory.
- [Contact Us](https://mediquee.in/contact), [Terms & Conditions](https://mediquee.in/terms), [Privacy Policy](https://mediquee.in/privacy), [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://mediquee.in/refund-policy).
